Landing.heroSubtitle: Evaluate recurring bills with transparent weighted scoring, detect hidden subscriptions, and receive deterministic decision safeguards—100% under your control.
Landing.evaluatorSubtitle: Rate any recurring service from 1 to 5 to compute an audit-proof 0–100 score.
Landing.priceInvalid: Enter a valid amount in MYR (e.g. 15.90).
Landing.resultEmpty: Rate the five criteria and calculate to see the deterministic score.
Landing.whyFormula: Each rating contributes (rating ÷ 5) × its weight. The five contributions sum to the 0–100 score.

whyExplanation.keep: High value across the weighted criteria. This subscription earns its monthly cost.
whyExplanation.review: Moderate value. Worth a periodic review to confirm it still fits your usage and budget.
whyExplanation.downgrade_or_pause: Low value. Consider downgrading to a cheaper tier or pausing until you need it again.
whyExplanation.consider_cancelling: Very low value relative to its cost. Consider cancelling and redirecting the money.

Landing.feature1Desc: No AI hallucinations for math. Pure TypeScript scoring ensures 100% repeatable, explainable results.
Landing.feature2Desc: Extract recurring candidate transactions from bank CSVs and text-based PDFs with Papa Parse & PDF.js.
Landing.feature3Desc: Balance usage, necessity, affordability, uniqueness, and satisfaction before deciding to keep or cancel.
Landing.feature4Desc: Zero direct banking logins required. PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) protects user records.
Landing.deterministicNote: Calculated deterministically via 5 weighted criteria with decision-tree safeguard rules applied.
Landing.overviewSubtitle: A live forecast from your actual subscriptions — not a static mock.
Landing.parserSubtitle: Extract recurring payments from bank CSVs and text-based PDFs — then you decide.
Landing.stepUploadDesc: Drop a CSV or text-based PDF bank statement. Nothing is uploaded to a bank.
Landing.stepDetectDesc: We surface possible recurring charges with their cadence and amount.
Landing.stepConfirmDesc: Every candidate needs your explicit confirm or reject. Nothing auto-approves.
Landing.parserHygiene: Papa Parse & PDF.js · Raw statements are deleted immediately after extraction.
